correctness.rationale: Exact symmetric F3 bidegree-(4,4) curve with 16 rational points: the four-chart unit-ideal Gröbner tests yield smooth genus nine, and 24 projectively normalized root-free quartics reduce to six smooth forms in one PGL2(F3) orbit. Quotient G(S,T,U) is a smooth plane quartic with eight tame branch points. Independently reconstructed genus-nine Hasse–Witt coefficient matrix has rank eight, simple zero characteristic factor and stable rank eight; its 8x8 minor is 1 and det=0 mod3. The quotient matrix has det=2 mod3, so JQ is ordinary. A prime-to-three isogeny JQ×P→JC gives Prym (p-rank,a)=(5,1), dim6. Independent symbolic checks reproduce Hasse matrices; script-based finite orbit certification is exact but separate from the isogeny argument.
